title: Category filter + text search
description: Filter bar (category select + text search) that swaps the list fragment via hx-get
spec:
1. Confirm a filter bar with a category select and a search input renders above the inventory list.
2. Select a category; confirm only items in that category are shown and the list fragment is swapped via hx-get (no full page reload).
3. Reset the category to 'all'; confirm all items return.
4. Type a term matching an item name; confirm the list filters to matching rows via hx-get.
5. Confirm search also matches item notes, case-insensitively.
6. Combine a category selection and a search term; confirm both filters apply together (AND).
7. Confirm a search with no matches renders a clear 'no results' fragment, not an error.
8. Confirm the filter inputs are labeled and keyboard-usable.
